description:
Commit 66eb8531 added a # Errors section to RevocationChecker::check_revocation that uses two nonexistent Error variant names:

- Error::CertRevoked → should be Error::Revoked
- Error::OcspExpired → no such variant; OCSP expiry returns OcspStatusUnknown; CRL expiry uses CrlExpired

These are broken intra-doc links. Reproduces with:
  RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --all-features -p pkix-revocation
  error: unresolved link to `Error::CertRevoked`
  error: unresolved link to `Error::OcspExpired`

This would cause docs.rs builds to fail under -D warnings (the standard docs.rs setting).

Fix: change the # Errors section to reference the real variants: Error::Revoked and Error::CrlExpired / Error::OcspStatusUnknown.
title: pkix-revocation: check_revocation doc references nonexistent Error::CertRevoked and Error::OcspExpired variants
